title: Operations Manager for eCommerce Agency
description:
We are a growing eCommerce agency working with multiple international clients, and we are looking for a sharp, highly organized, and high-energy Operations Manager who can also handle project management at a strong level.



This is a very important role inside the business.



You will be the person responsible for helping keep the agency organized, making sure tasks are clearly delegated, deadlines are met, communication is strong, and team output is high quality. This is not a passive role and not a basic admin role. We need someone who can think fast, move fast, lead properly, and keep the team aligned.



This role is best for someone who has real experience in operations, team management, project management, eCommerce, and client communication.



What You’ll Be Responsible For

Operations and Team Management



-Manage the day-to-day operations of the agency

-Oversee remote tea
mbers and make sure everyone is aligned and productive

-Delegate tasks clearly and properly based on priority and skill level

-Follow up with tea
mbers to make sure tasks are moving and deadlines are being met

-Spot bottlenecks, delays, and weak performance early and address them fast

-Help improve accountability, structure, and overall team discipline



Project Management



-Take client requests, meeting notes, Loom videos, and feedback and turn them into clear, actionable tasks

-Assign tasks inside ClickUp or other project management tools with proper context, deadlines, and priorities

-Make sure tasks are not just posted, but actually understood by the team

-Keep projects moving forward without needing constant follow-up from the owner

-Ensure urgent tasks are handled on time and important items do not get delayed



Quality Control and Delivery



-Review work before it goes back to the client

-Make sure deliverables are accurate, polished, and aligned with what the client asked for

-Catch mistakes, weak output, or missing details before submission

-Maintain strong internal quality control across all active client projects



Client Communication



-Help manage client communication in a professional, clear, and confident way

-Send updates, follow-ups, and replies on time

-Make sure clients feel taken care of, updated, and supported

-Understand the client’s priorities and communicate them clearly to the team



Systems and Process Improvement



-Improve internal workflows and agency systems

-Help build better SOPs, structure, and processes

-Suggest ways to make the business more efficient

-Identify areas where automation or better systems can save time and improve delivery



What We’re Looking For



-Proven experience as an Operations Manager, Project Manager, or similar leadership role

-Strong experience in eCommerce, websites, and digital marketing environments

-Excellent written and verbal English communication

-Strong leadership and delegation skills

-Very organized, detail-oriented, and proactive

-Able to work with urgency and manage multiple moving parts

-Strong problem-solving ability

-Comfortable managing remote teams

-Comfortable using tools like ClickUp, Slack, Google Workspace, Loom, and similar platforms

-Able to take ownership and reduce the owner’s workload, not add to it



Big Plus If You Have Experience With



-Shopify

-WordPress

-Klaviyo

-Customer support workflows

-Order processing

-Inventory updates

-Canva or basic design coordination

-CRM and automation tools

-Agency operations

-Managing multiple client accounts at once



Important for This Role



This is a full-time, high-focus role inside a small but growing agency.



Because this position is crucial to daily operations, we are looking for someone who can give this role their full attention and energy. You must not have other jobs or active side commitments that will affect your focus, availability, or performance here.



We need someone fully committed, dependable, responsive, and ready to take real ownership.



Who This Role Is For



This role is for someone who:



-likes structure

-can lead people properly

-knows how to manage pressure

-can keep projects organized

-communicates clearly

-has strong urgency

-takes pride in keeping the business running smoothly

title: HR Generalist
description:
The HR Generalist is responsible for the accurate, day-to-day administration of the company’s human resources functions, with particular emphasis on payroll integrity, benefits administration, compliance, and employee lifecycle support. This is a full-time, dedicated role requiring consistent availability, meticulous attention to detail, and ownership of recurring audits and reconciliations. The HR Generalist serves as a reliable point of contact for employees and management and ensures that all HR processes are executed completely, accurately, and on schedule.



-----



## Essential Duties and Responsibilities



### Payroll & Paychex Administration



- Process and review full-cycle payroll through Paychex, ensuring accuracy of hours, rates, deductions, and tax withholdings each cycle.

- Conduct thorough, documented audits of Paychex data on a defined schedule (e.g., each pay period and monthly), reconciling discrepancies before payroll is finalized.

- Maintain accurate employee records in Paychex, including new hires, terminations, status changes, and compensation updates.

- Generate and review payroll reports, flagging anomalies and resolving issues proactively.

- Ensure payroll-related compliance filings and records are complete and submitted on time.



### Benefits Administration



- Administer employee benefits programs, including enrollments, changes, and terminations.

- Reconcile benefits invoices against enrollment records and resolve billing discrepancies.

- Serve as a resource for employee benefits questions.



### Compliance & Recordkeeping



- Maintain accurate, organized, and confidential employee files and HR documentation.

- Support compliance with applicable labor laws and internal policies.

- Assist in preparing for and responding to audits, ensuring documentation is accurate and readily available.



### Employee Lifecycle Support



- Coordinate onboarding and offboarding processes, ensuring all steps are completed and documented.

- Support recruitment activities as needed, including job postings, scheduling, and candidate communication.

- Respond to employee inquiries promptly and professionally.



### Reporting & Accountability



- Track and report on assigned HR metrics and deliverables.

- Provide regular status updates to the supervisor and maintain transparent records of completed work.

- Meet established deadlines and quality standards consistently.



-----



## Required Qualifications



- Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field, **or** equivalent combination of education and experience.

- Minimum **3 years** of hands-on HR generalist experience, including direct payroll processing.

- **Demonstrated, hands-on experience with Paychex** (or comparable payroll/HRIS platforms) including running and auditing payroll.

- Proven ability to perform detailed reconciliations and audits with a high degree of accuracy.

- Strong working knowledge of HR practices, payroll fundamentals, and benefits administration.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

- Reliable high-speed internet, a suitable home-office setup, and the ability to maintain a consistent full-time schedule with the required time-zone overlap.



## Preferred Qualifications



- SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR, or equivalent HR certification.

- Experience supporting U.S.-based employers and familiarity with U.S. payroll and compliance practices.

- Experience working remotely with distributed teams.



-----



## Core Competencies



- **Attention to Detail** — Produces accurate work and catches errors before they reach finalization.

- **Accountability & Ownership** — Takes full responsibility for assigned deliverables and follows through to completion.

- **Reliability** — Maintains consistent, full-time availability and meets commitments.

- **Integrity & Confidentiality** — Handles sensitive information with discretion.

- **Communication** — Keeps stakeholders informed with clear, timely updates.

- **Organization** — Manages multiple priorities and recurring deadlines without lapses.



-----



## Work Environment & Expectations



This is a fully remote, full-time position. The successful candidate is expected to be available and responsive during agreed working hours, maintain accurate time and activity records, and deliver work product that meets quality and timeliness standards. Performance will be evaluated against defined deliverables, audit accuracy, and adherence to schedule.

title: Youtube Post-Production Manager
description:
This Is a YouTube-First Role



This is not a traditional post-production manager role. We are specifically looking for someone with deep experience in YouTube-native content, where success is driven by pacing, retention, iteration speed, and audience engagement, not traditional film, TV, or broadcast workflows.



If your background is primarily in film, television, or commercial post-production with long timelines or on-set focused processes, this role will not be a good fit.



If you’ve worked closely with creators, managed YouTube editors, shipped content weekly, and think about edits through a performance and viewer-retention lens, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.



Who We Are:



Five years ago, Dragonfruit set out to bring together some of the most talented visual storytellers, viral video strategists, and big-name clients, to change the way we create and consume on YouTube.The result has been bigger than we could have imagined, having generated billions of organic views and hundreds of millions of subscribers for creators like MrBeast, Ali Abdaal, Chris Williamson, Codie Sanchez, Neil Patel and orgs like Y Combinator, e.l.f beauty, WHOOP, ClickUp, Linktree, Center for Humane Technology & more.





Unlike other social media agencies or YouTube businesses, Dragonfruit refuses to celebrate a “creator economy” that trades viewers’ time and attention for rapid-fire dopamine entertainment.





Instead, we are leading a global movement to make YouTube a more valuable and educational place for all people; where views and subscribers are never an end in and of themselves, but rather a means of increasing human flourishing; where viral-educational YouTube channels not only bolster awareness and impact for our client's brands, but also create genuine value in viewers’ lives.





The Role:



As a Post-Production Manager at Dragonfruit, you’ll sit at the operational center of some of the most influential YouTube channels in the world — ensuring that hundreds of videos each month move smoothly from edit to delivery without sacrificing quality, speed, or storytelling impact.



You’ll oversee the end-to-end post-production process across multiple client accounts, coordinating with editors, creative directors, and producers to make sure timelines are met, files are organized, and every piece of content leaving the studio reflects Dragonfruit’s standards of excellence. You’re not just tracking edits — you’re architecting the systems that make world-class content possible at scale.





You’ll identify workflow inefficiencies, establish clear SOPs, enforce QC standards, and act as the connective tissue between creative and operations. Success in this role means becoming the person everyone relies on to keep post-production running at peak performance — calm under pressure, obsessed with detail, and relentless about shipping great work on time.





Skills and Qualifications:



3+ years of experience specifically in YouTube content production within an agency, production company, or YouTube-focused environment

Proven experience editing high-performing YouTube long forms

Proven experience reviewing and improving other editors’ work — with the ability to give clear, actionable, and constructive feedback

Proven ability to manage large-scale, multi-client pipelines, overseeing 300+ assets in various stages of post-production simultaneously.

Deep understanding of the creative workflow — from ingest and assembly through QC, revision management, and final delivery.

Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (especially Premiere Pro and After Effects) and familiarity with collaborative tools like 
, ClickUp, Notion, or similar project-management platforms.

Strong organizational and systems-thinking mindset — able to spot process bottlenecks and implement scalable solutions.

Exceptional attention to detail and ability to maintain high quality standards under tight deadlines.

Experience leading and mentoring editors teams, setting clear expectations, and managing bandwidth.

Expert communicator and problem solver with strong interpersonal skills

Bonus: familiarity with YouTube analytics, retention data, and how editing choices affect performance.





What you can expect:



An exciting creative startup culture – operate cross-functionally, wear several hats, and occasionally work long hours, during evenings, and/or weekends. We are a hungry and ambitious group of people trying to accomplish something large and challenging and we’re looking for folks who are enthusiastic and willing to do what is required to reach their goals.

Personal growth – use Dragonfruit’s culture of excellence as an incubator to improve your professional skills, learn new mental models, sharpen your critical thinking, and operate at the forefront of new media.

Be a key player in a fast-growing company – help take the company from 40 employees to 100+, identifying blind spots in our service offering and working collaboratively with leadership to improve systems/processes.

Earn more – take advantage of regular performance-based raises, generous referral and sales commissions, & more.





Perks:



Work from anywhere (we're 100% remote)

Competitive Healthcare Coverage (medical, dental, vision)

Gifts/cash bonuses on birthdays, work anniversaries, and other work-related achievements

Unlimited reimbursements on book purchases (we like to read )

Paid volunteering: 1 day dedicated to supporting a cause of your choice

Work directly with some of the largest creators/brands on the planet

Work for a company that is values-oriented and committed to positive social impact



If you're ready to join Dragonfruit and play a role in the future of YouTube, apply now!

s, phone numbers, and social media profiles - for high-level executives in the healthcare industry.

* LinkedIn Mastery: You know how to navigate LinkedIn inside and out to research target companies, map out organizational hierarchies, and track down specific healthcare prospect information.

* Spreadsheet Proficiency: You are highly proficient with Google Sheets (or other major spreadsheet tools). You know how to organize data cleanly, format lists professionally, and ensure information is easy for a sales team to read and action.

* The "Detective" Mindset: Standard sales databases often have missing or outdated information on small rural hospitals, while large staffing agencies might be listed in databases, finding the exact departmental or regional leader requires digging deeper. 

You must know how to look past a company’s public-facing website and use data tools, Boolean strings, public healthcare registries (like NPI records), and social media platforms (especially
, which rural hospitals frequently use as their primary local news outlet) to uncover direct contact details.

* Gatekeeper Diplomacy & Phone Verification: When online data runs dry, you are entirely comfortable picking up the phone to fill in the gaps. Crucially, you view receptionists and administrative assistants as allies, not obstacles. You know how to use professional charm, build quick verbal rapport, and ask the right questions to get them to willingly help you map out the internal team.



Key Responsibilities:

* Targeted Company Mapping: Research and build a database of target hospitals and healthcare staffing agencies based on specific geographic and size criteria.

* Contact Discovery: Identify the exact right decision-makers and extract their direct phone lines and verified, working
 addresses. This includes:

          * C-Level Executives: CEO, CFO, and COO.

          * Credentialing Decision-Makers: Anyone who oversees provider enrollment, credentialing compliance, or medical staffing. You will target titles such as Director of Credentialing, Credentialing Manager, Director of Medical Staff Services, Medical Staff Office (MSO) Coordinator, or Director of Revenue Cycle / Revenue Director (where credentialing falls under billing).

* Trigger & Needs Research: Dig deep into company job boards, news releases, and social media to identify current "buying triggers" or urgent staffing/operational needs.

* Competitor Intelligence: Investigate and document if the prospect is currently utilizing an existing vendor or competitor product, noting their current setup whenever possible.

title: Funnel Specialist
description:

We’re looking for a highly analytical and execution-focused DTC Funnel Optimization Specialist who can identify conversion bottlenecks, implement high-impact fixes, and continuously improve the customer journey across our eCommerce client portfolio. This role exists to bridge the gap between paid acquisition and on-site conversion performance, ensuring traffic generated by our Paid Media Strategists converts at the highest possible rate. You’ll own the diagnosis, testing, implementation, and reporting of funnel improvements while helping scale winning conversion strategies across multiple brands.



Requirements/Experience:

- Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with Paid Media Strategists and internal stakeholders



- High attention to detail and strong bias toward execution and accountability



- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, performance-driven remote environment



Roles & Responsibilities for this position:



- Conduct monthly audits of each client’s full acquisition funnel, including the transition from ad creative to landing page/PDP, add-to-cart flow, checkout experience, and post-purchase confirmation journey



- Analyze funnel performance data using GA4, Triple Whale, Shopify Analytics, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, and related tools to identify drop-off points, friction areas, and conversion opportunities

Implement updates to product detail pages (PDPs) using Shopify-native apps and templated modules without requiring custom Liquid development

 System Optimization: Develop, scale, and optimize high-throughput model inference steps and resolve backend production bugs.

title: Remote Lead Sourcer
description:
Title: Remote Lead Sourcer / Lead Generation Researcher — 75 Leads/Day (Aesthetics & Health Niche)



Company: PureVision Enterprise — a growth infrastructure agency that builds automated booking systems for aesthetic clinics and med spas in the UK and US.



Type: Remote, independent contractor



Schedule: Flexible hours, Monday to Friday. This is research work, not phone work, so you can work whenever suits you as long as the daily lead target is hit and the lists are ready for our callers each day.





The Role



You are the engine room of our outreach. Your job is to find and qualify the right businesses every day and deliver them into our tracker clean and ready to call. The leads you source are assigned straight to our calling team, who contact them and book appointments. The more quality leads you produce, the more the whole team can sell. Your output directly drives the business.



The Target





75 qualified leads per day, Monday to Friday.

A lead only counts when it is complete and accurate (see required fields below).

Quality matters as much as volume. Junk or duplicate leads don't count.





What You'll Do





Source businesses in the aesthetics and health niche across the UK and US: aesthetic clinics and med spas, cosmetic and Invisalign dentistry, hair transplant and hair loss clinics, weight loss and GLP-1 clinics, dermatology, cosmetic surgery, fertility and IVF, and private physio, chiro, and osteo.

Use free scraping and research tools (Google Maps extractors, directories, free Chrome scraping extensions) to pull at volume, then verify and enrich each lead.

Find the decision-maker (owner, principal, or clinic manager), a direct phone number, and the Instagram handle for each business.

Qualify each business fits our criteria before logging it.

Enter every lead into our tracker with all required fields complete and correct.

Keep the pipeline full so our callers never run dry.





Required Fields Per Lead



Every lead must include: business name, decision-maker name, direct phone number, Instagram handle, location, niche/category, qualification note, and date sourced. Website if available. A lead missing any required field is not counted.



What We're Looking For





Fast, accurate, and detail-oriented, able to keep quality high at volume

Experience with lead generation, list building, or research, and comfortable with scraping or data extraction tools

Confident in spreadsheets and CRMs

Strong written English for verifying names and details

A stable internet connection and the discipline to hit a daily target without being chased

Bonus: experience with Google Maps scrapers, free data extraction tools, GoHighLevel, or similar





Pay



£100 per month, paid monthly, for hitting the daily target of 75 qualified leads Monday to Friday.



How to Apply



Send a message with:





A short note on your lead generation or research experience and any tools you use

A sample: source 10 qualified leads in our niche using the required fields above, so we can see your quality and speed (we'll share a simple format template)

Your availability: which days and how many hours per day you can commit, and your timezone

Confirmation you can consistently hit a daily lead target Monday to Friday





Applications without the 10-lead sample won't be considered. We're hiring quickly and will reply to strong applicants within a few days.

title: Sales & Operations Specialist – Extended Shift | Cleaning Company
description:
Elevated Cleaners is a growing residential cleaning company based in Charlotte, NC. We run on strong systems, high standards, and a small team of high-ownership people. This role is fully remote and plays a direct part in both revenue and daily operations during our extended hours.



About the Role

This is a high-responsibility position combining sales, operations, and client communication during evening and weekend hours — when lead volume is active and jobs are in progress. You will be the first point of contact for every inbound lead that arrives during your shift, and you will own the schedule and all client interactions until your shift ends.

This is not a passive role. You will be expected to move fast, stay organized, and take full ownership of outcomes.



What You'll Do



Sales — Respond to inbound leads, answer questions confidently, handle objections, and close bookings. Every unconverted lead gets consistent follow-up until a decision is reached. Sales is the top priority at all times.



Operations — Own the evening and weekend schedule. Coordinate cleaner assignments, monitor active jobs in real time, and resolve any scheduling conflicts, access issues, or timing problems as they come up.



Customer Experience — Handle all client messages and calls during your shift, including booking requests, reschedules, complaints, and post-clean follow-ups. Every complaint must be resolved before your shift ends.



Cleaner Hiring and Sourcing — Actively source candidates, communicate with applicants, and move them through the hiring pipeline. This is treated as an ongoing priority, not a secondary task.



Administrative Tasks — Use lower-activity periods to complete assigned tasks in 
, including social media content and other business tasks as directed.



Schedule

Wednesday – Friday: 2:00 PM – 10:00 PM Eastern NYC Time

Saturday – Sunday: 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM Eastern NYC Time

Monday and Tuesday off

This is a fully remote role. You must be available, responsive, and active during all scheduled hours.



Compensation

$500/month base plus a multi-layer performance package including:

- Commission on closed bookings

- Close rate incentive based on monthly conversion performance

- Company-wide bonus tied to overall business execution

Total compensation typically ranges from $700 to $1,000/month, with top performers earning at the higher end consistently.



What We're Looking For

Proven sales experience with confidence closing deals (required)

Strong written and spoken English for client communication (required)

Spanish fluency for cleaner coordination (required)

Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities at once

Proactive, independent, and reliable during shift hours

CRM experience, especially Go High Level, is a strong plus

Cleaning or home services background is a plus



Team Structure

This is a small, owner-led company. You will work directly with the owner and operate independently during your shift. There is no bureaucracy, no layers, and no confusion about expectations. You will always know exactly what is expected and how you are performing.



Growth Opportunity

As the company grows, compensation and responsibilities grow with it. This role offers direct exposure to how a real service business is built and run, with opportunities to take on more responsibility over time. If you perform well, that will be recognized and rewarded.



To Apply

Submit your application directly through this listing and include the following:

- Your resume

- A voice memo of 60 to 90 seconds introducing yourself, summarizing your work experience, and explaining why you would be a strong fit for this role

- Your WhatsApp number

Applications without a voice memo will not be reviewed. This is a required part of the process, not optional. Top candidates will be contacted directly for a brief intro call. We move quickly. If you are a strong fit, you will hear from us fast.

title: AI Specialist & Automation Architect (ChatGPT, Claude, M365, Workflow Automation)
description:
About the Role:



We are looking for a highly skilled and proactive AI Specialist from the Philippines to join our team. We are currently developing custom AI solutions designed to support our district managers and leadership teams with daily operational audits, policy compliance, and employee performance tracking. As we transition our initial AI prototypes into company-wide rollouts, we need an expert to help us scale these systems, automate day-to-day workflows, and seamlessly integrate AI tools across our various departments (including operations and marketing) and existing tech stack. 



Work Schedule: This is a remote position that requires working during standard business hours in Eastern Standard Time (EST).



Key Responsibilities:



AI Development & Scaling: Manage and refine existing conversational AI models, optimizing prompts to extract actionable insights from standard daily operational reports.  



Data Architecture & Integration: Architect and manage scalable cloud integrations (e.g., mapping custom models to a master corporate OneDrive) to bypass native AI file upload constraints and establish a unified knowledge base.  



Data Integrity & Maintenance: Continuously clean, structure, and update backend training data to eliminate AI hallucinations, ensuring all technical and operational guidance is 100?curate.  



Workflow & Document Automation: Develop automated systems that seamlessly format conversational AI outputs into compliant, exportable, print-ready documents (such as PDFs or Word files) directly from the interface.  



Privacy & Security Controls: Implement robust security protocols and access controls to isolate chat histories on shared workplace devices, safeguarding sensitive corporate data and personal information.  



Multi-Platform Integration & Programming: Evaluate and program integrations with alternative advanced AI engines (such as Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, or others) and automation frameworks (like n8n) to continuously expand and upgrade our system's capabilities.  



Multimedia Expansion: Assist in building out dynamic resources, including mapping text-based troubleshooting prompts to external instructional video playlists.  



Required Skills & Qualifications:

- Proven experience building, configuring, and scaling Custom GPTs and AI chatbots.  

- Strong understanding of the Microsoft 365 ecosystem (specifically OneDrive integration with AI platforms).  

- Experience exploring or building with alternative AI models like Anthropic Claude or Google Gemini.  

- Experience with prompt engineering methodologies (Context, Person, Results framework is a plus!).  

- Familiarity with workflow automation tools (e.g., n8n, Zapier, Make).  

- Ability to troubleshoot latency issues and optimize AI response times for fast-paced work environments.  

- Excellent problem-solving skills, particularly regarding data privacy, user access controls, and dynamic document generation.  - Must be available to work dedicated hours in Eastern Standard Time (EST).





To Apply:

Please include examples of past AI bots or automation workflows you have built, particularly any projects involving Microsoft 365/OneDrive integrations, multi-platform AI use (e.g., Claude, Gemini), or dynamic document generation.

title: Hiring an Exceptional Operations Assistant – FLUENT English & Outstanding Organizational Skills Required
description:

The Mission-Critical Role That Keeps Our Engine Running at Peak Performance



Are you the kind of person who spots a problem before anyone else even knows it exists? Do you view every challenge as an opportunity to build something better?



If you are an exceptionally talented, high-energy operator who loves turning chaos into clarity, watching metrics move in the right direction, and being the behind-the-scenes powerhouse that makes an entire team look unstoppable—this is your launchpad.



We are a lean, fast-growing company. That means we experience real growing pains, but it also means your footprint here will be massive. If you want to punch a clock at a slow, bureaucratic corporation, this isn't for you. But if you have an entrepreneurial spirit, a positive worldview, and a deep appreciation for the chance to build a legacy, you’ll fit right in.



What You’ll Own (and Crush) Every Single Day:

- The Final Gatekeeper: Review every single end-of-day report from the team—you are the final quality checkpoint before leadership sees the numbers.



- Accountability & Compliance: Monitor staff activity logs, time-tracking data, and live screen activity to maximize daily productivity.



- Strict Timekeeping: Enforce clock-in/out compliance with zero tolerance for slippage. Integrity starts with the basics.



- Quality Assurance: Listen to call recordings with a trained ear, scoring interaction quality and fiercely protecting our brand’s reputation.



- Field Team Performance Dashboards: Own the Marketing Representative metrics (tracking visits completed, referrals secured, audio submissions). You’ll know exactly who is crushing it and who needs a fire lit under them.



- Lead Control & Inbound Response: Track every single new lead and pull voi
s first thing every morning. Nothing goes cold on your watch.



- Marketing & Ad Tracking: Monitor Google Ads positioning and core metrics to ensure we are pulling in maximum ROI.



- Hiring Support: Assist in interviewing job applicants to help us scale the team with elite talent.



Who Thrives Here (Our Core DNA):

We filter heavily for culture. Skills can be sharpened, but character is set in stone. We are looking for an individual who embodies these specific traits:



- Coachable & Aligned: You are eager to learn, easy to direct, and can execute instructions precisely as given. You respect established systems while proactively solving the problems that arise within them.



- Accountable & Honest: You have total ownership over your work. If you make a mistake, you own it, fix it, and learn from it. Absolute honesty is our baseline.



- Positive Worldview & Gratitude: You approach life and work with a positive mindset and a genuine appreciation for opportunity. You help create a pleasant, motivating work environment.



- No Gossip, Period: We maintain a fiercely loyal, collaborative, team-first culture. We protect our peace—gossip and toxic politics are strictly forbidden.



- Execution-Minded: You move fast, adapt faster, possess massive confidence in your capabilities, and are genuinely eager to perform at a high level every single day.



- Experienced: You have 2+ years in operations, administrative, QA, or coordination roles (bonus points for call-center, sales operations, or agency experience).



Shift Hours:

- Monday – Friday

- 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM Eastern Time (USA)



How to Apply:

If reading this list gave you an adrenaline rush instead of anxiety, we want to meet you.



1. Apply now with your resume and a quick note telling us the most impressive operations “save” or process you’ve ever implemented.

2. Include a quick voice note telling us the most impressive operations “save” or efficiency process you’ve ever personally implemented.

3. Use the exact subject line: “I’m Your Next Ops Assistant – [Your Name]”



We move fast. Expect to hear from us within 24–48 hours if your profile stands out.



DON’T FORGET – AN AUDIO VOICE RECORDING IS REQUIRED TO BE CONSIDERED. APPLY NOW AND SHOW US YOUR VOICE!

While motion graphics are a part of the role, our primary requirement as far as advanced skillsets will be on 3D rendering (product and environment) and graphic design. You’ll collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including marketing, product development, and marketplace operations, to bring Sunco’s vision to life.



Key Responsibilities:

Lead and create visually compelling graphic design assets for digital and print media, including advertisements, banners,
 templates, social media posts, and more.

Design and produce high-quality 3D renders for product visualizations, marketing materials, and e-commerce marketplaces.

Collaborate with the marketing and product teams to create cohesive visual narratives for campaigns, websites, and product launches.

Use your motion graphics skills to enhance projects, such as web banners, social media ads, and short animations (motion graphics experience is a plus but not the primary focus).

Maintain consistent visual design standards that reflect the Sunco brand identity across all touchpoints.

Provide creative direction and design leadership within the team, offering feedback and mentoring to junior designers and tea
mbers.

Ensure that design work is delivered on time and meets the highest quality standards.

Stay up to date with current design trends, tools, and techniques to continually bring fresh ideas to the table.

Other tasks as assigned.



What You’ll Have

Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Industrial Design, 3D Animation, or a related field.

title: Residential Cabinet Drafter, Kitchen and Bath Elevations from Architectural Plans
description:
Overview

We are a custom cabinetry shop in Nashville, Tennessee. We take released architectural plan sets and produce the interior cabinet elevations that those sets do not include. We are hiring a drafter who knows residential cabinetry and can turn a complete plan set into clean, dimensioned cabinet elevations on a tight schedule. This is ongoing work. We run multiple projects at a time and we want a drafter we can rely on as a standing part of our process, not a one time hire.

The work

On a typical project we hand you a complete architectural set with floor plans, power plans, elevations, and sections. The set will not contain cabinet elevations. That is what you create. You will draw interior cabinet elevations for kitchens, islands, range walls, bath vanities, and other millwork areas, working entirely from the dimensions in the plans we provide.

Skills we require



Fluency in residential cabinet construction, including standard cabinet sizing, nomenclature, toe kick, counter and upper heights, crown, light rail, and filler logic.

The ability to read a full architectural set and pull dimensions accurately from floor plans, elevations, and sections.

Precision with appliance and fixture openings, clearances, and reveals, including the difference between a built cabinet and a freestanding furniture unit that needs an opening shown rather than a box.

Clean drafting discipline. Every elevation carries cabinet widths and heights, toe kick, counter height, upper cabinet heights, crown and light rail where they occur, appliance and fixture openings, and overall wall dimensions.

The judgment to flag a missing or conflicting dimension in a note rather than guessing. We would rather answer a question than correct a wrong assumption.

Comfort applying revisions we specify, such as adjusting a cabinet width or a clearance, and confirming those changes on the drawing.



Deliverables on every project



Dimensioned interior cabinet elevations for all cabinet areas in the set, delivered as both an editable CAD file and a PDF. We work in Cyncly and Mozaik, so a DWG or a clean PDF set is the priority, with the native file included. Tell us in your bid which platform you draw in.



Turnaround

Our projects move fast and many run on a 24 hour turnaround. Apply only if you can produce accurate work on a short clock and hold a stated deadline with confidence.



To apply

Send samples of comparable residential cabinetry elevation work, the software you draft in, and your rate. Strong candidates will be given a paid test project before we commit to ongoing work.

title: Dental Insurance / Treatment Plan Financial Coordinator
description:
A growing multi-doctor dental practice is seeking an experienced Dental Insurance & Treatment Plan Financial Coordinator to support an increasing volume of complex treatment cases. This role focuses on preparing the financial and insurance components of dentist-approved treatment plans, ensuring patients receive accurate cost estimates and helping the practice improve treatment acceptance.





This is a specialized dental support position and is not a general virtual assistant, front desk, scheduling, or basic billing role. Candidates must have hands-on experience with dental insurance verification, benefit interpretation, treatment plan financials, patient cost estimation, and prior authorizations.





Scope and Boundaries





The Dental Insurance & Treatment Plan Financial Coordinator is responsible for building the financial and insurance package associated with a treatment plan after it has been created and approved by the dentist. The coordinator does not diagnose, create, modify, or make clinical decisions regarding treatment plans. Their role is to accurately determine insurance coverage, estimate patient responsibility, identify non-covered services, and prepare documentation needed for financial consultations and treatment approval.







Core Responsibilities



Take dentist-approved treatment plans and create the corresponding financial and insurance package



Verify patient insurance benefits



Interpret coverage percentages and code-level coverage by plan



Identify which procedure codes are typically covered versus not covered



Flag non-covered services so the practice can bill its UCR (usual, customary, and reasonable) rate



Estimate the insurance-covered portion versus the patient’s out-of-pocket cost



Handle prior authorizations required before procedures



Prepare the materials the practice uses for the financial consultation with the patient



Support consistency and speed in getting patients back in for financial consults







Procedure Knowledge



The practice performs a range of complex cases the coordinator should be comfortable working with, including cosmetic dentistry, fixed and overdentures, dental implants, oral surgery, sleep apnea treatment, and neuromodulator treatment for TMJ.

title: Customer Support Agent (A-Players Only)
description:
Experienced CS Agent — High-Volume Dropshipping (A-Players Only)



We're not hiring someone to close tickets and clock out. We're hiring a killer CS agent who treats our support operation like it's their own business. If you read job posts looking for "tasks" and "responsibilities" to tick off — close this one. If you read them looking for an operation you can take ownership of and grow inside of, keep reading.



We run a 6–7 figure multi-brand e-commerce operation spanning 5 stores across the EU and US markets. We move fast, we scale hard, and we're building a backend team that runs like a machine. You'll join a backend team of 7 and work shoulder-to-shoulder with our Supply Chain Manager, Backend Manager, Dispute Manager, and CS team.



What this role actually is

This is a CS Agent role : high-ownership one. You'll be on the frontline of our support operation across all stores. (Got management experience? Even better : there's real room to grow here if your performance is good for 2 months. But make no mistake: this role is about being an elite agent first.)



This is not a "follow the SOP and wait for instructions" role. This is a "I saw a problem three steps before anyone asked, and I fixed it" role.



The single most important thing we're looking for

Ownership. You don't just clear your queue — you look beyond your own lane, spot problems early (refunds, fulfillment delays, chargebacks, disputes), and get ahead of them. Proactivity and work ethic rank above everything else. Show us that, and you get paid extremely well for it.



What you'll own

Customer service across all stores, at high volume, without dropping quality

Keeping tickets moving fast and flagging backend issues before they blow up

Staying tightly synced with supply chain and disputes so nothing falls through the cracks

Helping improve the systems that make the whole operation run smoother every week



Requirements (read carefully)



Minimum 3 years of CS experience in dropshipping — non-negotiable

You can handle a minimum of 20 tickets per hour. If you can't, don't apply.

Strong hands-on experience with Gorgias

You understand high-scale dropshipping — the volume, the margins, the chaos.

Strong experience with Claude / AI tools — this is core to how we operate; you need to be genuinely good with it

A relentless work ethic and an ownership-first mindset

Excellent written English and clear, fast communication



What you get



Well-paid base — we pay A-players like A-players

High KPI-based bonuses on top — your performance directly drives your income

A genuine chance to grow inside a scaling 6–7 figure business — the ceiling is high

A sharp, fast-moving backend team that takes the work seriously



Start date: Immediate. We're ready to move now and we want someone who's ready too.

How to apply



Don't send a generic application — show us how you take ownership.



Start your letter with the word OWNERSHIP. Applications that don't will not be considered.

Send a list of 3 stores you've previously worked for that generated at least $50,000+/month in revenue. If you don't have experience at that level, send the last 3 stores you worked for with a brief description of your responsibilities in each.

title: Video Editor - Content Creator Support
description:
Entrelingo Group is an Australian company operating across NAATI-certified translation, migration, skills assessments, and recruitment. We're building a content operation to grow our brand and we need an editor who turns raw footage into scroll-stopping, publish-ready content — fast and consistently.



THE ROLE

We record. You deliver. Raw footage comes from our founder and team. Your job: transform it into clean, high-impact content for Instagram and YouTube. Content is a core growth channel — we treat it that way.



SCOPE OF WORK (monthly)

- At least 45 short-form reels (Instagram / Shorts, under 60 seconds)

- 4–6 long-form YouTube videos



All content is in Spanish. You don't need to speak Spanish, but you must be comfortable working with it — syncing captions, cutting silences, following audio rhythm in a language that may not be your own.



WHAT EACH DELIVERY LOOKS LIKE

This is the standard we hold every video to — no exceptions:



- Hook in the first 2–3 seconds that stops the scroll

- Zero dead air — silences, filler words, and pauses are cut without mercy

- Tight pacing — every second earns its place, nothing coasts

- Smooth, intentional transitions — not template transitions, not random cuts

- Motion graphics and text animation that feel native to the platform

- Music selected to match the emotional tone of the content — not background noise

- Sound effects (SFX) layered deliberately and with purpose — they elevate the video, not decorate it

- Audio mastered correctly — vocals clear, music and SFX balanced, no clipping, no dead frequencies

- Color grading that looks intentional and professional, not filtered

- Accurate captions — styled, on-brand, and timed precisely

- Thumbnail creation for YouTube that earns the click

- Vertical (9:16) and horizontal (16:9) versions delivered when required

- Files named, organized, and delivered in the correct specs for each platform



REQUIRED TOOLS

You must have strong working knowledge of the following. We'll ask about your workflow with each one.



Editing:

- Adobe Premiere Pro and/or DaVinci Resolve — advanced level, not intermediate

- Adobe After Effects or CapCut Pro for motion graphics and text animation

- Descript for transcript-based editing and silence removal



Audio:

- Adobe Audition or equivalent for audio cleanup and mastering

- Epidemic Sound, Artlist, or Musicbed for licensed music

- Soundsnap, Zapsplat, or equivalent SFX library — sound effects are not optional in our content

- Splice or similar for custom audio assets



Captions and subtitles:

- Descript, CapCut, Rev, or equivalent — accuracy and visual style both matter



Review and delivery:

- 
 or equivalent for feedback and version control



Additional:

- Canva Pro for YouTube thumbnails

- Topaz Video AI or equivalent for footage enhancement when needed

- Familiarity with AI-assisted tools (Runway ML, Pika, or similar) is a strong plus

- Notion or Airtable for tracking deliverables



WHAT WE CARE ABOUT

Experience level matters less than output quality. One year of experience with exceptional edits beats five years of average work. What we cannot compromise on is craft — pacing, sound design, and the ability to make a talking-head video feel alive.



What we need to see:

- A portfolio with real examples — reels, talking-head content, or brand videos. No portfolio = no review, no exceptions.

- Proof you've edited for a real brand or creator (not just personal projects)

- Videos where the sound design is clearly intentional — music, SFX, and audio balance working together

- Someone who flags problems AND proposes solutions without being asked



SELECTION PROCESS



Shortlisted candidates receive a test edit (no payment for the test), real raw footage from our team, in Spanish. You apply your full skill set: cut the silences, clean the audio, choose the music, layer in the sound effects, caption it, make it feel right. The best edit wins the role.



This is how we find out who actually delivers versus who interviews well.



YOU'RE THE RIGHT FIT IF:



- You've edited content in a language that isn't your native one (Spanish experience is a big plus)

- You treat sound design as seriously as the visual edit — you know SFX make or break a video

- You're fast without sacrificing quality

- You don't need hand-holding on every decision

- Deadlines are non-negotiable for you

- You're genuinely obsessed with the craft — you notice bad edits in other people's videos and you can't let them go



TO APPLY, SEND:

1. Your portfolio link — required, no exceptions

2. A short message describing your editing process, the tools you use daily, and how you approach sound design

3. One piece from your portfolio you're most proud of, and why — specifically mention the sound decisions you made



Applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed.

description:

This role is a high output Video Editing Specialist with lead editor upside, responsible for producing conversion focused direct response video ads at scale for paid social and supporting the performance creative team with rapid iteration.



Company: Confidential  

Website: 
  

Language: English  

Availability: Part Time (20 hours / week), Full Time (40 hours / week)  

Time Zone: Flexible  

Work Type: Freelance, Remote  

Niche: Fitness & Sports Equipment  

Payment (Negotiable): On Request  



Role Details  

N/A  



Responsibilities  

- Produce 100+ short form video ad assets per week for direct response paid social across Meta, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and IG Reels  

- Turn raw footage, scripts, AI generated footage, and voiceovers into native platform ads with strong hooks, pacing, and clear CTA alignment  

- Edit with accurate captions, on brand motion graphics, music selection, sound design, and supportive B roll to improve retention and conversions  

- Build full AI generated video ads end to end using tools such as Veo 3, Kling 3.0, and Seedance, then assemble VO, scenes, subtitles, graphics, and music into a polished final  

- Collaborate with the Head of Performance Creative to iterate on creatives quickly based on performance testing needs  

- Maintain organized project files and a repeatable workflow to hit high volume deadlines consistently  

- Provide quality control and feedback loops (senior or lead editor track), helping raise the bar across outputs  

- Support longer form edits when needed (horizontal YouTube content and VSL style edits)  



Must-Haves  

- Ability to produce high volume output, targeting 100+ video assets per week for direct response paid social  

- Strong direct response editing experience for established ecommerce, DTC, or digital product brands (no dropshipper style work)  

- Fast, clean editing in Premiere Pro, CapCut, or comparable, with ads that feel native to Meta, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and IG Reels  

- Proven skill with hooks, pacing, captions accuracy, music and SFX, B roll usage, and cohesive storytelling from hook to CTA  

- AI capable: can create full AI generated video ads using Veo 3, Kling 3.0, Seedance, and voiceovers via ElevenLabs, then assemble into finished creatives  

- Strong spoken and written English, including clean grammar in captions and the ability to present on calls  

- Working, well organized portfolio with playable links (applications without a portfolio are not considered)  

- Ability to work with PST and maintain at least 4 hours of daily overlap  

- Individual freelancer only, not an agency and not a consultant with a small editing team  



Nice To Haves  

- Experience editing fitness, mobility, joint health, or wellness direct response creatives (testimonials, before and after style narratives, educational angles)  

- Strong horizontal editing skills for YouTube videos and VSL style deliverables  

- Familiarity with performance creative testing and rapid iteration systems for paid social

, or ClickUp for task tracking and feedback cycles

- Clear hiring path: portfolio review, paid trial, interview with Head of Performance Creative, final interview with founding members, offer

- Remote, flexible hours with defined overlap expectations for collaboration (PST overlap required)

The successful candidate will support production workflows, coordinate material procurement requirements, assist with drafting activities, and help ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards.

* Strong understanding of build-to-print manufacturing and fabrication operations.

* Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical documentation.

* Experience working with structural steel, fabrication, or industrial manufacturing projects.

* Strong production planning, scheduling, and workflow management experience.

* Experience supporting procurement and fabrication planning activities.

* Practical understanding of laser cutting, plate processing, and fabrication workflows.

* Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.

* Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.

* High attention to detail and accuracy.

* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.



Preferred Software Experience



Experience with the following systems will be highly regarded:



* AutoCAD

* Autodesk Inventor

* Fusion 360

* KeyCreator

* Microsoft Office 365

* Microsoft Teams

* Production Planning Software

* Quality Management Systems (QMS)



What We Are Looking For



The successful candidate will demonstrate:



* Strong engineering, fabrication, and manufacturing knowledge.

* Ability to accurately interpret engineering drawings and specifications.

* Excellent production planning and scheduling capability.

* Ability to prepare accurate procurement lists, BOMs, and material schedules.

* Strong understanding of fabrication workflows and manufacturing processes.

* Strong commercial awareness and cost-control mindset.

* Excellent organisational and prioritisation skills.

* Strong leadership and team coordination skills.

* Results-oriented with a focus on quality and efficiency.

* Ability to build positive working relationships across all levels of the business.

* Committed to delivering projects in full, on time, and within budget.

title: Systems & Automation Specialist (No-Code Workflows)
description:
**Part-time. Remote. Clay, Notion, reporting, and automations.**



---



## The short version



I run a small agency. There's a lot going on behind the client work. Lead lists, outreach, reporting, internal tools, automations. I build most of it myself right now. I've got to the point where I need someone to own it.



This is not an admin or VA role. I need someone who thinks in systems. You look at a process and work it out. When this happens here, that should happen there. And it stays clean while it does.



Do you like taking a messy workflow and making it simple? Then this is a good fit.



---



## What the role is



Most of the work is "if this, then that" logic across tools. You also keep the data behind it clean.



A lot of it looks like this. We take raw data. We run it through a chain of checks and steps. We clean it as it goes. Then we send each record to the right place on its own. That's one system. There are more like it. There's the Notion side too, which keeps the work in order. And the reporting side, which keeps the numbers honest.



Here's the key part. This is a build role, not a run role. I've got people who run the day to day. The reports, the outreach, the uploads. What I'm missing is someone who owns the systems under all of that. You design them. You automate them. You fix them when they break. You make them simpler so the team moves faster. You build the machine. You don't turn the handle on it each day.



You don't need to know every tool I use. You need to be the type who can open a new one and work out the logic. That counts more than any tool on your CV.



---



## What you'd be doing



The work splits into a few areas. You won't own all of it on day one. But this is the shape of it.



**The outreach system**

- Own the setup in Clay. That's the logic that finds the right people. It adds company data, writes custom lines, then routes each record to the right place.

- Build the checks that keep the data clean. No repeats. No wasted credits.

- Set up the exports. Records should flow into our outreach tools on their own.

- Build the systems behind our shared inbox.



**Notion**

- Build and look after the databases. Clients, briefs, creative, creators, payments.

- Set up the automations, views, and templates. The team then works from one clean system.

- Move data in cleanly. Keep the naming the same throughout.



**Reporting and data**

- Build the pipelines so the numbers pull in clean. Spend, revenue, MER, aMER, and margin. They come fro
ta, Google, and Shopify.

- Look after the Looker Studio dashboards. And the connectors that feed them, like Windsor.ai or Supermetrics.

- Automate the manual steps. No one should redo them by hand each week. The weekly Slack digest is one.



**Automation across tools**

- Build the "if this, then that" logic across Clay, Notion, Sheets, Slack, and the outreach tools. Use Zapier or Make.

- Link the tools so data moves clean. And nothing gets typed in twice.



**Keep it simple and clear**

- Write short guides so each process can be re-done. It shouldn't live in one head.

- Test things well before they go live.

- Spot when a system is too big. Then make it smaller.



---



## The kind of person I want



- You think in systems, not tasks.

- You're at ease in tools you've never used.

- You like the logic problem, not just the clicks.

- You spot repeats, gaps, and mess that others miss.

- You'd rather make a thing simpler than bigger.

- You can explain how a system works in plain words.

- You test before you trust.



Read the example up top. Did you think "what's the key, where's the dedupe, how many tables is this"? Then you're the right type.



---



## Tools you'd work in



You don't need all of these on day one. But this is the world you'd work in.



- Clay, for lead data and routing

- Notion, for databases and guides

- Zapier or Make, for automation

- Google Sheets and Looker Studio, for reporting. Plus a connector like Windsor.ai or Supermetrics.

- Shopify, Meta, and Google Ads, to pull data. Not to buy media.



Strong logic and the will to learn beat deep skill in one tool.



---



## The details



- **Hours:** Starts part-time. Around 10 to 20 hours a week. There's more here than that, so there's real room to grow.

- **Where:** Remote. I work with people across time zones. Where you are isn't the issue. Being reliable and clear is.

- **Pay:** $5 an hour, based on skill. Or we agree a fixed price to build the core systems first.



---



## How to apply



Don't send a long cover letter. Send me this.



1. A short note on a system you built or fixed. And what made it work.

2. One tool you'd never used, picked up, and got good with.

3. Your answer to this. The same company shows up as five rows in my list. How would you stop that?



Keep it plain and simple. If you can think clear on that last one, we should talk.

title: Senior SEO Specialist - Programmatic / Location-Page Indexing + GEO/AIO (Part-Time)
description:
About the role:



I run the personal-brand website of an international keynote speaker (TV-featured, Top 1% / CSP). The site is built on Craft CMS with the SEOmatic plugin, runs in 3 languages (DE / EN / ES), and has roughly 180 pages, including programmatic "keynote speaker in [city]" location pages.



I have solid SEO knowledge myself and built parts of this. I'm not looking for a beginner to learn on my site - I'm looking for an expert to take the wheel strategically and operationally.



The core problem (be honest with me about this)



Many of my programmatic location pages are stuck on "Crawled — currently not indexed" in Google Search Console. Organic traffic and, more importantly, inquiries dropped significantly.



My priority is clear: get my existing location pages indexed again and found at scale - both in classic SERPs and in GEO/AIO (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews). Right now these pages are ~90% identical to each other (same testimonials, logos, stats, FAQ - only the city name and one paragraph change), which I suspect is why Google won't index them. I need someone who can fix that root cause and make these pages genuinely indexable and findable - not just polish thin pages.



What you'll do:



Diagnose the indexing problem and give me a prioritized 30-day plan.

Get my existing location pages re-indexed and ranking at scale by making them genuinely differentiated - or recommend consolidation/pruning where it's the right call. I want your honest opinion, even if it contradicts me.

Fix technical SEO: indexing, crawl efficiency, internal linking, hreflang / international SEO across DE/EN/ES, structured data.

Strengthen the personal-brand entity for both classic SEO and GEO/AIO (getting recommended by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews): entity/schema, off-site footprint, reviews, directories, press.

Implement the work yourself (in Craft) and surprise me with new GEO/AIO ideas to future-proof the site.



Must-have (non-negotiable):



Verifiable track record getting programmatic / location-page sets indexed AND ranking - with real URLs and GSC/GA screenshots, not claims.

Strong technical SEO: indexing diagnostics, crawl budget, hreflang, schema/entity.

Active, demonstrable experimentation with GEO/AIO (AI Overviews, Perplexity, ChatGPT visibility).

Willingness to prune, consolidate, and challenge my strategy when the data says so.

Fluent written English.



Nice-to-have



Experience with Craft CMS / SEOmatic (or comfort working in an unfamiliar CMS).

Multilingual SEO (DE/ES a plus).

Personal-brand / local-service or expert-website experience.



You're NOT a fit if:



Your plan is "write more pages" or "spin up better templates" without solving the thin-content/duplication root cause.

Your growth playbook is mostly link buying.

Your "case studies" are screenshots you can't tie to a live, verifiable URL.



How to apply (read carefully - this is the filter):



Start your message with the word CRAWL-BUDGET so I know you read this.

Send 2 verifiable case studies: live URLs of location/programmatic page sets you built, plus GSC or GA screenshots showing indexing/traffic improvement.

Answer these three short questions (3–4 sentences each):



- Most of my city pages are "crawled, currently not indexed," and I haven't spoken in many of these cities yet. What's your honest first hypothesis and your approach?

- Under what circumstances would you tell me to delete or merge pages instead of optimizing them?

- How would you get an AI engine (ChatGPT / Perplexity / Google AI Overviews) to recommend a keynote speaker - which signals off the website matter most?



Engagement:



Part-time, ongoing. We start with a paid audit + prioritized 30-day plan (fixed scope) so we both see how you work before committing long-term.

Please include your part-time rate and your availability per week.



I read every application that follows the steps above. Generic copy-paste pitches will be ignored.

title: Can You Diagnose a Broken Google Ads Campaign? Prove It & Get Hired
description:
Job Title: Media Buyer (Google Ads) — Work on High-Spend, High-Impact Campaigns

Location: Philippines — Remote

Salary: 30,000 – 40,000 PHP / month

Type: Full-time

Experience: Minimum 1 year in Google Ads or paid media



About AdCeptive Media/

AdCeptive Media is a Dubai-based performance marketing company. We run paid campaigns for global eCommerce and lead generation clients — real budgets, real CPA targets, real accountability. We hire slowly, pay fairly, and give people who execute ownership of their work.



The Role:-

We need a Google Ads Media Buyer who can take a campaign brief and run with it. You will launch, manage, and optimize Search, Display, and Call-Only campaigns for lead generation clients. You will work under direct supervision following our campaign SOPs. You are not expected to independently own a new vertical from day one. You are expected to follow a framework, hit KPI targets, and flag problems before they become expensive.

If you need hand-holding on every decision, are comfortable with vague campaign briefs, or cannot explain why a CPA spiked — this role is not for you.



What You Will Do:-



• Launch and manage Google Ads campaigns across Search, Display, and Call-Only with proper structure and conversion tracking from day one

• Hit CPL and CPA targets — not just manage campaigns, but optimize them down

• Conduct keyword research, write ad copy variants, and run A/B tests on creatives, bids, and landing page hypotheses

• Set up and verify conversion tracking via Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics, and CAPI before any campaign goes live

• Submit weekly performance reports with diagnosis and next actions — not just numbers

• Identify scaling opportunities on accounts hitting targets and flag deterioration on those that aren't

• Collaborate with landing page and creative teams to improve funnel conversion rates

• Join client calls and internal reviews; communicate professionally across time zones





Must-Have Skills:-



• Minimum 1 year managing Google Ads campaigns (lead generation experience preferred)

• Solid understanding of Search campaign structure: match types, bid strategies, Quality Score, ad groups, negative keywords

• Can explain CPL, CPA, ROAS, CTR, and CPC fro
mory — and knows which metric matters most for which campaign type

• Hands-on experience with Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics for conversion setup

• Has run A/B tests and can explain what was tested, what happened, and why

• Strong written and spoken English

• Can work independently in a remote, async environment across time zones



Nice to Have:-

• YouTube Ads experience

• Pay-per-call campaign exposure

• Experience with call tracking tools (CallRail, WhatConverts, Redtrack,Ringba etc.)

• Basic understanding of landing page optimization and funnel structure





What We Expect in Your First 90 Days:-

Day 1: Complete tool access setup, review one campaign and submit written observations to your manager by end of day, read and sign off on our Google Ads SOP.

First 30 days: Launch at least one campaign with full conversion tracking. Deliver weekly reports with specific optimizations taken. Bring one existing campaign's CPL down by a measurable amount — or write a clear diagnosis of what's blocking it.

First 90 days: Fully own your assigned accounts with minimal check-ins. Hit or beat target CPL/CPA on at least two accounts. Submit one scaling proposal for a high-performing account. Build a testing framework for at least one account.



Our Hiring Process:-

We run a structured process. Missing any requirement at any stage is an automatic rejection — not to be harsh, but because following instructions is the core skill this role demands.



1. Application review — compliance and experience check

2. Structured survey — technical skills, work ethic, self-management (40–45 min, no AI tools)

3. Paid trial task — a real campaign audit with a written plan and a Loom walkthrough

4. Culture interview — 45 min with the Hiring Lead, including a live walkthrough of your trial

5. Founder interview — 30 min, final call and offer discussion

The trial is paid. It takes 4–8 hours of real work. You will receive a simplified version of our Google Ads SOP before you start and your plan must follow it.



HOW TO APPLY:-





 your application to: 

Subject line — exact format, no variation: FirstName-LastName-GoogleAdsMediaBuyer-Philippines (Example: Maria-Santos-GoogleAds MediaBuyer-Philippines)



Your
 must include all of the following — missing any single item = no reply:-



1. CV / résumé as a single PDF:-

2. Google Ads portfolio link or samples (live accounts, case studies, or anonymized screenshots with results)

3. A plain-text two-paragraph answer written directly in the
 body: describe the single best result you have produced in a Google Ads campaign and exactly how you produced it

4. Your current monthly compensation in USD equivalent and your available start date

5. A photo of your workspace

6. A Speedtest.net screenshot showing minimum 25 Mbps download / 10 Mbps upload

description:
Job Title:

Senior Full-Stack Developer (Next.js + Supabase) – AI Chatbot Platform Builder



Job Overview:

We are looking for a highly skilled, execution-driven Senior Full-Stack Developer to build a single-tenant B2B AI Chatbot platform from scratch.



This is a Full-Time, Project-Based position for exactly 1 month (4 weeks) to build and launch the Core MVP. After the platform is successfully launched, the role will transition into a part-time monthly retainer (10 hours/month) for system maintenance, server monitoring, and future feature rollouts.



You will be working directly with the founder. You must be an expert in building clean user interfaces, setting up bulletproof database structures, and orchestrating AI workflows.



Core Platform Architecture (What you will build):

Super-Admin Panel (For Us): Simple login where we can create client profiles, input system prompts, upload documents, and generate a tiny embedded script tag for the client’s website.

Client Dashboard (For the Businesses): A secure portal where clients can log in to view their live chat logs, track captured leads (names,
s, phone numbers), and see simple usage analytics.

AI/RAG Engine: Seamless integration with OpenAI API using EU-data-residency endpoints. Document embedding, text chunking, and secure vector storage.

Web Scraping Feature: Integration of Firecrawl API to crawl dynamic, JS-heavy client websites, convert the data into clean Markdown, and upsert it into the database.

The Chat Widget: A lightweight, blazing-fast, and beautiful frontend chat widget (Tailwind CSS) that clients can easily embed into their dynamic websites.

Required Technical Stack:

Frontend: Next.js (React), Tailwind CSS.

Backend & Database: Node.js (TypeScript) + Supabase.

Database Security: Expert knowledge of Supabase Row Level Security (RLS) to keep client chat-logs strictly isolated.

AI & Data: OpenAI, Claude, Gemini API, Vector Embeddings (pgvector in Supabase), and Firecrawl API.

Infrastructure: Hosting deployment on Vercel and Supabase (strictly locked to EU regions for GDPR compliance).

Requirements:

Minimum 5+ years of experience as a Full-Stack Developer.

Proven track record of building and shipping live SaaS products or complex AI implementations.

Ability to write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.

Strong communication skills and fluent English.
